title: Business case review
description: A consistent comparison of project options, delivery constraints and expected benefits.

sources.title: HM Treasury, Developing business cases for projects and programmes

rules.instruction: State the decision, problem and success criteria. Compare feasible options against continuing with the current approach using a shared time horizon and scope.
rules.verification: Check that the same outcome, cost and delivery assumptions were used across options and that the recorded recommendation follows the stated criteria.

rules.instruction: Name the owner of each material benefit, the intended measure and when it will be reviewed after implementation.
rules.verification: Check that the plan shows how the owner can observe each claimed benefit and who will decide if results fall short.
